item.title: docs: milestone roadmap diagram in the README and ROADMAP
item.body:
Refs #324 (the board itself lives on the issue; this PR only links it from the docs)
Claim: ext/opus-helper1
Author model: Claude Opus 5.5

**Problem.** After the MVP, nothing said which lots make up a shippable step. The README only had the phase table, which describes what is being built, not what ships.

**Cause.** #166 tracked the MVP only, and `LOTS.md` is the plan, not the state.

**What changed:**
- Four milestones group the 153 lots of `LOTS.md`: 🚀 M1 MVP, 📖 M2 read & reply complete, ⚙️ M3 engine complete, 🏁 M4 final version. Their live kanban boards are on #166 (M1) and #324 (M2–M4), outside this PR.
- `README.md`: a "Milestones" subsection under the phase table (not instead of it), with the diagram and a table linking each milestone to its board.
- `docs/ROADMAP.md`: a "Milestones" section with scope and exit criteria for each, plus the diagram. The intro no longer says that #166 tracks everything.
- `docs/assets/roadmap-milestones.svg` and `.excalidraw`: the diagram, drawn with the Excalidraw MCP.
  - The sources are in `docs/assets/source/roadmap/`: `elements.json`, plus the architecture diagram's `export.html` and `export.js` with the output renamed.
  - Virgil is embedded, so GitHub renders the SVG without fetching fonts. The downloaded tools are git-ignored.
- `LOTS.md` is not edited.

**Checks.**
- `python3 scripts/check-lot-deps.py`: 153 lots, 0 violations.
- `markdownlint-cli2@0.18.1`: 0 errors.
- The SVG was rendered in Chromium and checked by eye.
